tasks.title: Consolidate and deduplicate findings into .sir/backlog.md rows and the audit disposition index
acceptance: Pre-session backlog content is preserved byte for byte (declared preserved behaviour, newly tested): `head -c 1066 .sir/backlog.md | sha256sum` prints `c46d358d5bb3df126f84c4b87546e79427796be7da930b6631818e8438194792`, the sha256 of the whole 1066-byte file at 5b7d9a6 (measured with `sha256sum` and `wc -c` on the base worktree copy during spec).

Every appended line is a well-formed row per contracts/finding-format.md section 5: `tail -c +1067 .sir/backlog.md | grep -cvE '^2026-11-23 20261123-0703-codebase-audit \[(correctness/security risk|convention drift|hygiene)\] .+ Where \(at 5b7d9a6\): .+ Why: .+ Verify: .+ \(audit: (DA|IW|DB|FE|NT|CT|RP)-[0-9]{3}(, (DA|IW|DB|FE|NT|CT|RP)-[0-9]{3})*\)$'` prints `0`, the same command with `-cE` prints a positive integer, and the control `head -c 1066 .sir/backlog.md | grep -cE '<same regex>'` prints `0` (the two pre-session rows, which carry no tag, must not match).

Each appended row carries exactly one severity tag: `tail -c +1067 .sir/backlog.md | grep -oE '\[(correctness/security risk|convention drift|hygiene)\]' | wc -l` equals `tail -c +1067 .sir/backlog.md | wc -l`.
The appended region holds no blank line and the file ends in a single LF: `tail -c +1067 .sir/backlog.md | grep -c '^$'` prints `0` and `tail -c 1 .sir/backlog.md | od -c` shows `\n`.

`.sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/README.md` exists with level-2 headings `## Audit files`, `## Dispositions`, `## Merges` per contracts/finding-format.md section 6, and `## Audit files` names each of the seven layer audit files.

No finding is silently dropped: `grep -hoE '^### (DA|IW|DB|FE|NT|CT|RP)-[0-9]{3}' .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/backend-domain-application.md .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/backend-infrastructure-web.md .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/database.md .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/frontend.md .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/tests-dotnet.md .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/tests-client.md .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/repo.md | cut -c5- | sort` and `grep -oE '^- (DA|IW|DB|FE|NT|CT|RP)-[0-9]{3} — ' .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/README.md | cut -c3-8 | sort` produce identical output (`diff` prints nothing), so every finding ID has exactly one disposition line.

Rows and `row` dispositions correspond one to one: `tail -c +1067 .sir/backlog.md | sed -nE 's/.*\(audit: ([^)]*)\)$/\1/p' | tr ',' '\n' | tr -d ' ' | sort` equals `grep -oE '^- (DA|IW|DB|FE|NT|CT|RP)-[0-9]{3} — row$' .sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/README.md | cut -c3-8 | sort`, and the first of these piped to `uniq -d` prints nothing (no ID in two rows).

Each appended row's severity is the highest (correctness/security risk > convention drift > hygiene) among the Severity fields of the audit records its `(audit: ...)` list names; checked for every row.

Each appended row's `Where (at 5b7d9a6):` segment holds the union of the Location values of the records it names (above ten sites, the first ten plus `(+<n> more, see audit <ID>)`), and its What, Why and Verify carry the substance of those records; checked for every row.

Every `existing` disposition names one of the two pre-session rows (the `GetUserInfo` layout/validator row or the `didInit` restatement row) and the finding it disposes asks for the same change; and no appended row asks for either of those two changes (adding `GetUserInfoValidator` / renaming `UserInfoResponse`, or restating the `didInit` bullet of `.sir/disciplines/react.md`).

No two appended rows ask for the same change: every pair of appended rows sharing a Location path is checked and describes different changes; every multi-ID row has a line in `## Merges` naming its IDs and why they are one change.
Every `withdrawn` disposition names the contracts/finding-format.md section 3 check that failed, and the reviewer reproduces that failure against the cited record.
Appended rows are ordered by severity (correctness/security risk, then convention drift, then hygiene), then by their first audit ID.

The task's commit changes exactly `.sir/backlog.md` and `.sir/sessions/20261123-0703-codebase-audit/audit/README.md` (`git diff --name-only <startRef> <task tip>`); the seven layer audit files are unchanged by it.
